choose_tree_tip: Select a Newick / NEXUS tree file (Ctrl+O)
format_tip: Detected from the extension when you pick a file. Correct it manually when the extension disagrees with the contents (NEXUS saved as .txt, for example); the current file is then re-read in the new format.
polytomy_tip: Either raise an error on polytomies, or resolve them randomly into bifurcations
outgroup_check_tip: Error, or only warn, when a multi-tip outgroup is not a complete monophyletic group (--outgroup-check)
run_calibrate_tip: Requires a finished RRF analysis and at least one calibration point
export_tip: Export CSV / NEXUS / JSON / PNG and the equivalent CLI script (Ctrl+E)
warnings_tip: Inspect the warnings emitted by the OpenRelTime engine
cli_placeholder: # Equivalent CLI commands appear here once you run an analysis
copy_cli_tip: Copy the equivalent CLI commands to the clipboard
example_tip: Load the 24-taxon example tree and three demo calibrations shipped with the app (Ctrl+I); no data needed to try the full workflow
